notes.title: 5 reasons why we think the Symbiotic Pistol is the coolest sci-fi weapon
notes.content:
In FORECLOSED, Evan Kapnos is in constant danger with a veritable army of well-armed agents constantly trying to take him down. Fortunately, he has something special to help him fight back, the Symbiotic Pistol. Here’s 5 reasons why we think the Symbiotic Pistol is the coolest sci-fi weapon out there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/d2831102d1636f52f5e490e5a1e3dff85fdce5ee.png

1.	It is unique.
Our hero Evan Kapnos has a truly unique weapon by his side with the only Symbiotic Pistol in existence. There is nothing else like the Symbiotic Pistol and this gives Evan an edge over the forces conspiring against him. 

2.	It needs no ammo.
Evan is always outmanned but never outgunned. The Symbiotic Pistol doesn’t require ammo, so Evan never needs fear that he’ll run out of ammo in the midst of an intense firefight. 

3.	It has multiple uses.
A truly adaptive weapon that can adapt to your play style. Having trouble with shield carrying enemies? There’s an upgrade for that. Need some extra oomph? Load up with exploding bullets and let rip.

4.	It looks cool.
A sleek and exotic take on the standard sidearm, it has an iconic look and perfectly captures the futuristic cyberpunk setting. It’s not just style over substance either, the Symbiotic Pistol delivers in combat.

5.	It is linked directly to our hero
There’s a reason it’s called the Symbiotic Pistol. The weapon links directly to Evan’s implants and creates a unique risk/reward game mechanic where you can balance firepower with the risk of overloading Evan’s implants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/8a22178a7a54456f87d7db1a6d6c36e935018abb.png

What do you think? Looking forward to getting your hands on the Symbiotic Pistol? Come and let us know on Discord.
